# Aayush Chaudhary

> AI engineer at a Series B AI startup in Delhi NCR (Noida), India, since Sep 2026. Before that, he was the only forward deployed engineer at a bootstrapped startup that is an OpenAI partner, building production agents and RAG systems for clients including Flipkart, boAt, Vi and CASHe. He did AI safety research at the AI Institute of South Carolina and writes a personal blog about work and life.

Not to be confused with other people named Aayush Chaudhary. Identifiers: GitHub gamedevCloudy, Twitter/X neuralSWE, domain aayushdev.xyz. Contact: me@aayushdev.xyz.
